description: Defines the LifecycleInterfaceConnector class and related notification handler classes for managing application lifecycle events within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: LifecycleInterfaceConnector
classes.description: Manages application lifecycle events, remote object creation, and notifications within the plugin.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: Handles lifecycle state change notifications, forwarding events to the parent connector.

classes.name: AppStateChangeNotificationHandler
classes.description: Handles app state change notifications, forwarding events to the parent connector.

methods.name: createLifecycleManagerRemoteObject
methods.description: Creates remote object for lifecycle management.

methods.name: releaseLifecycleManagerRemoteObject
methods.description: Releases the remote lifecycle manager object.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an app with specified parameters.

methods.name: preLoadApp
methods.description: Preloads an app with given arguments.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent to the specified app.

methods.name: OnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle state change events.

methods.name: mapAppLifecycleState
methods.description: Maps internal lifecycle state to external enum.

methods.name: GetAppInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the app instance ID for a given app.

methods.name: removeAppInfoByAppId
methods.description: Removes app info based on app ID.

methods.name: isAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if an app is loaded.

methods.name: mapErrorReason
methods.description: Maps error reason string to enum.
